title: geogen traffic lane graph, version 1
description: The 'traffic' section of a geogen manifest / chunk index (geogen/traffic.py). World space, metres, +Y up. Lanes are directed polylines resampled every 'step' metres; a vehicle is (lane, s, v) and follows the points. A lane's end is its stop line; 'successors' are the lanes (connectors through an intersection, or the next lane) it may continue on.

kind.description: lane: a street lane between intersections; connector: a movement through an intersection; route: an explicitly declared road.

speed.description: Speed limit (m/s), already capped by the lane's curvature.

end.description: exit: vehicles leave the world at this lane's end (open routes).

signal.description: Lanes ending at traffic lights: which intersection and phase they follow.

kerb.description: Distance from the lane centre to the kerb on its right (m).

crosswalks.description: s-ranges (metres along the lane) that cross a crosswalk: yield to people there.

conflicts.description: Connector pairs in one intersection whose paths come within a vehicle width: a vehicle claims the zone before entering its s-range.

crosswalks.description: Painted pedestrian crossings as plan rectangles [x0, z0, x1, z1]: NPCs cross the road on them.

cycle.description: signals: seconds of green, amber and all-red per phase (phases take turns).

offset.description: signals: seconds the cycle is shifted by (world time).
